meta.name: Nikasha framework
meta.status: Working example on synthetic data. Not clinically or academically validated.
meta.placeholderNotice: All weights and thresholds are placeholders pending a stakeholder panel. Nikasha has not been calibrated against real adoption outcomes.

certainty.label: Actual clinical use
certainty.description: Deployed in routine care with audited local results.

certainty.label: Peer-reviewed publication
certainty.description: Published in a peer-reviewed journal. Preprints and arXiv do not count here.

certainty.label: Live demonstration
certainty.description: Shown working on cases chosen by the assessor, not by the vendor.

certainty.label: Vendor document
certainty.description: White paper, brochure, slide deck or internal report.

modes.label: Administrative
modes.description: Affects workflow only (worklist order, protocol suggestion). A clinician reads every study unaided.

modes.label: Advisory
modes.description: Shows findings to a clinician who reads the study and decides.

modes.label: Triage
modes.description: Decides which studies are read first. A missed finding can delay care.

modes.label: Autonomous
modes.description: Issues a result that some studies receive with no clinician read.

modalities.label: X-ray (plain radiograph)
modalities.reason: X-ray tools are out of scope. Nikasha defines its false-negative and false-positive anchors for cross-sectional CT and MRI reads. A projection radiograph has different lesion conspicuity, reference standards and error profiles, so a score against these anchors would not mean anything.

modalities.label: Mammography
modalities.reason: Mammography is an X-ray technique and is out of scope for the same reason as plain radiography: the CT and MRI error anchors do not transfer to projection imaging.

modalities.label: Ultrasound
modalities.reason: Ultrasound is out of scope in this version. Only CT and MRI diagnostic tools are assessed.

modalities.label: PET or nuclear medicine
modalities.reason: PET and nuclear medicine are out of scope in this version. Only CT and MRI diagnostic tools are assessed.

gates.label: Regulatory authorisation
gates.description: Medical-device authorisation in the deploying jurisdiction covers this intended use.

gates.label: Data protection
gates.description: Processing of patient data complies with applicable law (in India, the DPDP Act 2023).

gates.label: Intended use matches deployment
gates.description: The autonomy mode being assessed sits inside the authorised intended use.

gates.label: Clinical accountability
gates.description: A named clinical owner and an incident-reporting route exist at the deploying site.

gates.label: Unsupervised reporting authorised
gates.description: The authorisation explicitly permits results issued with no clinician read.

parameters.label: Sensitivity (false negatives)
anchors: Not reported, sensitivity below 85%, or lower 95% CI bound below 80%.
Sensitivity 85 to 89% with lower 95% CI bound at least 80%.
Sensitivity 90 to 94% with lower 95% CI bound at least 85%.
Sensitivity at least 95% with lower 95% CI bound at least 90%, reported per finding type.

parameters.label: Specificity (false positives)
anchors: Not reported, specificity below 80%, or no false-positive rate per 100 studies.
Specificity 80 to 87%, false positives stated per 100 studies.
Specificity 88 to 93%, with false positives per 100 studies and the review workload they create.
Specificity at least 94%, false positives per 100 studies, and a review of what the false positives were.

parameters.label: External validation
anchors: Internal or development-set results only.
One external site, retrospective.
Two or more external sites, or one prospective external study.
Multi-site prospective validation on scanners and patients like those at the deploying site.

parameters.label: Subgroup and scanner robustness
anchors: No subgroup or scanner-level results.
Results split by one factor, such as scanner vendor or age band.
Results split by scanner vendor, field strength or slice thickness, and by age and sex.
As level 2, plus a failure-mode analysis showing where the tool is weak and what it does there.

parameters.label: Human oversight and override
anchors: Output cannot be overridden or audited; no record of what the tool showed.
Clinician can override and outputs are logged.
Override and logging, plus the image region or evidence behind each finding is shown.
As level 2, plus calibrated confidence, abstention on low-confidence cases and an audit report.

parameters.label: Post-deployment monitoring
anchors: No monitoring after deployment.
Vendor collects complaints only.
Periodic audit against local reference reads.
Continuous drift monitoring with preset thresholds that trigger review or withdrawal.

parameters.label: Workflow integration
anchors: Separate login and manual upload; no PACS or RIS link.
DICOM send and receive, but results shown outside PACS.
Results returned into PACS as DICOM structured report or secondary capture.
As level 2, plus worklist integration and structured report fields.

parameters.label: Deployment (edge or cloud)
anchors: Cloud only, hosted outside the country, no offline fallback.
Cloud only, hosted in-country.
Hybrid: inference on site, cloud used only for updates or analytics.
Fully on site (edge); works through an internet outage and no image leaves the hospital.

parameters.label: Update process
anchors: Silent or unannounced model updates.
Vendor-pushed updates with release notes.
Versioned updates scheduled by the site, with change notes and performance deltas.
As level 2, plus local re-validation before go-live and one-step rollback.

parameters.label: Source code and algorithm access
anchors: Closed source; no description of the algorithm.
Closed source; reviewable description of architecture and training data.
Source or weights available to auditors under a restrictive licence.
Open source under an OSI-approved licence, with weights and training recipe.

storage_cost.label: Storage and retrieval cost per study

tco.label: Five-year cost of ownership per study

infraFields.label: Grid carbon intensity where compute runs
